title: Design Add and Search Words Data Structure
description:
Design a data structure that stores words and supports searching with wildcards. Implement the `WordDictionary` class:

- `WordDictionary()` creates an empty dictionary.
- `addWord(word)` adds `word` to the dictionary.
- `search(word)` returns `true` if some previously added word matches `word`, where each `"."` in `word` can stand for **any single letter**.

Tests describe a sequence of calls as two arrays: the operation names (starting with the class name) and their arguments. The expected output has `null` for the constructor and for methods that return nothing.
constraints: Words passed to addWord contain only lowercase letters.
Words passed to search contain lowercase letters or ".", with at most 2 dots.
hints: Store the words in a trie.
When search meets a ".", try every child of the current node recursively.
